methodologyNote: Measured via page views of macOS desktop traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, macOS Catalina led macos versions (desktop) in Africa at 46.99% (market share of tracked page views / usage). macOS 19 ranked second at 35.16%, followed by macOS 15.7 at 2.19%.

faqs.question: Which item leads macos versions (desktop) in Africa?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina leads at 46.99% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/macos-version-market-share/desktop/africa.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for macos versions (desktop) in Africa?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina (46.99%), macOS 19 (35.16%), macOS 15.7 (2.19%) in October 2026.
